_about: A week in which the open-loops scan ran, read everything, and found nothing. check-audit.sh passes this to every older digest assertion, so they keep testing exactly what they tested before open loops existed (2026-09-22). Since 2026-10-04 it also carries the account's alert totals, read in full and all zero, so the digest's security line reads 'none open' rather than 'not checked'.
